subject.title: feat(config): use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should datetime-suffixed config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, or may the migration prune them when the suffix scheme changes?
rationale: Config backups can be a user's only recovery copy, and repository policy plus VISION.md make config recovery and migration behavior compatibility-sensitive rather than automation-only.

options.title: Preserve legacy recovery points
options.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new bounded datetime retention set without silent loss.

options.title: Prune legacy numbered backups
options.body: Accept that the first cleanup after the change may delete existing numbered backups in exchange for a timestamp-only scheme.

options.title: Keep the numeric ring
options.body: Decline the naming change for now and keep the documented five-slot numeric recovery model.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy recovery points
recommendation.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new bounded datetime retention set without silent loss.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest available routing signal for config compatibility and recent backup-test history.
